chunks: By the Lote-tree beyond which none can pass,

key_terms.الْمُنْتَهَى: The boundary, the limit, the utmost end
key_terms.سِدْرَة: Lote tree, a specific tree in heaven

ai.seo_question: What is the Sidrat al-Muntaha in Islamic theology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the Sidrat al-Muntaha is not merely a physical boundary but the locus where the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) received the divine commandments, marking the transition from prophetic revelation to the ultimate reality of divine presence. This site symbolizes the culmination of the spiritual journey, where the veil between the created and the Creator is lifted, affirming the unique status of the Ahl al-Bayt as the inheritors of this profound knowledge.
